title: Reparenting joints with RigidBody2D introduces jarring offset
body:
### Tested versions

- Tested in 4.4.1.stable, project has FMOD and AnimatedSprite2Player addons

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable (49a5bc7b6) - Windows 10 (build 19045) - Multi-window, 2 monitors - Vulkan (Forward+) - dedicated AMD Radeon RX 5700 (Advanced Micro Devices, Inc.; 32.0.11027.2001) - AMD Ryzen 5 5600G with Radeon Graphics (12 threads)

### Issue description

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/cfc35418-6d9f-4aa0-968c-8a7c049e4494

I struggled to implement procedural scarf physics into my game using RigidBody2Ds connected via PinJoint2Ds, however, the position values of each RigidBody2D in the chains' offsets suddenly after reparenting (screen transitions reparent relevant Nodes to a CanvasLayer so they're above the screen fade)

### Steps to reproduce

Here's both codes that reparent the scarf (separate node in tree, just referenced by player script) from an "Entities" Node2D to a "TransitionFocus" CanvasLayer.

Mind the freeze() and panic() functions, those don't really do anything in this case unfortunately, I figured resetting physics interpolation of the scarf node's children (which are RigidBody2Ds linked together by PinJoint2Ds) and switching between freeze states would do something but, alas, nothing 😔 

Scarf scene tree:
![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ca3be1df-ccd8-4935-b071-afaf9c5326b0)
